item.title: Gradient Descent in the ALPS: Abstracted Low-Poly Stylization and Fabrication
item.description: The paper presents a method for generating fabricable 2D low-poly style images from a given input image by optimizing the mesh geometry, topology and a fixed color palette using score distillation sampling.
